title: LangGraph stateful workflows
subtitle: Design an explicit workflow without confusing checkpoints with business commits.
goal: Represent a stateful workflow as explicit transitions
intro: LangGraph is useful when branches, resumptions, and state updates need deliberate structure.
terms: A step receiving and updating state
case: A request workflow pauses for review and later resumes.
State transitions are inspectable independently of the model's prose.
A replayed node can repeat an external write unless effects are protected.
